routines.errorAssessment: For valid live descriptors this is a read-only accessor with no CSPICE error condition to manufacture. Missing-target cases are harness preflight, not raw error coverage. Actual-backend tests reject expired/invalid handles; reviewed allocation/ownership prerequisites prevent unsafe descriptor corruption.
routines.fixtureRationale: No kernels or external files. Authored integers, binary-exact fractions, ASCII string keys and interval endpoints; backing storage is always allocated before use. Unsafe arbitrary/corrupt CSPICE descriptors are not passed to the oracle.
routines.cleanup: Each workflow uses registered once-only cell/window finalizers on success/error and resets runtime state. Same-instance integration tests free all surviving handles, reset error state and dispose clients in finally; opaque tokens reject foreign/expired identities and registry prerequisites preserve original storage bounds. No handles or kernel state escape a case.
routines.tolerance: Existing recursive comparator preserves complete lengths/keys/order. Integers, ASCII strings and binary-exact fractions/endpoints use unchanged 1e-12 absolute/relative threshold; no rounding, normalization, tolerance relaxation or fixture-derived expected constants.
